title: fix(news): the PR gist writer reads the diff, not only the description
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: The PR gist writer now includes changed-file diffs, not just file names and change counts. It caps each diff at 3,000 characters and total diff text at 40,000, while listing lockfiles and test snapshots without their diffs. Updated instructions tell the writer to ground summaries and image prompts in the diff, omit unsupported claims from PR descriptions, and mention user prices only when the diff changes what users are charged. Tests cover skipped diffs and both size limits.
